data.name: Lysandros
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'lysos' meaning 'loose' or 'free', and 'andros' meaning 'man' or 'warrior'. In ancient Greece, this name was given to those who were liberated from slavery. In Christian tradition, it is believed to represent a free man in Christ, liberated from the bondage of sin.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of spiritual freedom and liberation from sin.
